pinterest.title: Headphones On Sign | Printable Do Not Disturb Desk & Door Sign
pinterest.description: A gentle focus-mode sign for desks and doors, letting others know headphones are on and deep work is in progress. Printable do-not-disturb wall art for home offices, classrooms, and neurodivergent-friendly workspaces.
